draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane).

coaching.headline: Two clean Fangtooth/Primal aces behind a fed Sparrow won it, even with three lanes read as theirs.
coaching.team: Offlane, support and carry were all read as theirs, but we won on objective tempo and two decisive aces. The 14.4 Fangtooth fight (4-1) flipped the early game, and the 26.8 Primal Fangtooth ace (4-0) closed it — towers ended 10 to 5. Sparrow went 12/4 as the carry. Our one weakness was a pair of trades: the 12.9 river loss (0-3), softened by taking Fangtooth in the same window, and the 23.7 loss (1-3) taken with a man up — that one is a fight to win outright. The good news is we answered the threat: Aurora (24k magical) was their biggest damage source and the late fights still went our way.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Winning the 14.4 Fangtooth fight (4-1) and the 26.8 Primal Fangtooth ace (4-0) behind a fed Sparrow (12 kills) — fighting on our own pits answered Aurora's 24k magical.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase was the game's quiet MVP — 18 assists, only 1 death, and 17897 healing across the map. This is the support performance that lets a fed carry close; nothing to change.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Serath went 4/0 — zero deaths and 22k damage as the offlane, even though the lane was read as theirs all game. Goldilocks324 was in the 14.4 Fangtooth ace. Flawless positioning; Goldilocks324 turned an unfavored matchup into a non-issue by simply never dying into it.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Carry of the game — Sparrow 12/4/7, 18k into objectives, and present for both aces. The Vanquisher at 25 and Imperator at 36 kept Cuban Noobster online. The lane was read as theirs early but Cuban flipped it; keep farming safe and letting the team open fights for the carry.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gadget went 5/5/11 and Willy Guggenheim was in the 14.4 ace. The 12.9 trade and the 26-minute solo catch by Aurora are the ones to skip — as a ranged setup mid, Gadget's value is poke and zone from the back; don't get pulled into coin-toss trades with no objective up.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera was the favored jungle and Xeebs was everywhere the objectives were — present for both aces and the 30.8 close (5-2). 7 deaths is the watch-out, some from the 12.9 and 23.7 bad trades. Xeebs sets the pace; reset after a bad invade rather than re-flipping it, and this is a clean game.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
ourKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
ourKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
ourKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

One main mage and one main marksman at most.

fedBy: Tainted Scepter (Malice): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice.• Stacks up to 15 times.• Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly.• Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
lines: Lead story: Soaked the fights. 647 damage mitigated a minute, more than 91% of Iggy & Scorch mid players this patch.
Inferno at rank 3: 85s base, about 57.4s by the end (32% shorter) from 48 ability haste: Golem's Gift 15, Lifebinder 15, Tainted Scepter 10, Soulbearer 8.
6 takedowns (4 kills, 2 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Iggy & Scorch dealt 22,634 hero damage, 25% of their team's, with +335 magical power from items.

Penetration: Caustica ignores 35%; against Khaimera (level 17: about 105 magical armor, 68 after penetration; took 14,573 magical damage from heroes, 54% of all hero damage they took) and Gadget (level 18: about 49 magical armor, 32 after penetration; took 12,799 magical damage from heroes, 77% of all hero damage they took) that is about 22% and 13% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Sustain: 12% magical lifesteal; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 2,095 healing recorded.
Toughness: +200 health, +40 physical armor; took 25,585 damage, mitigated 20,047, died 4 times.

Lesson: Iggy & Scorch's penetration cut through: Khaimera took about 22% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 their armor was about 105, about 68 after 35% penetration).

Loadout augment Turret Maniac: You can have 4 turrets out, but each is easier to kill. Spread them around a fight or objective to zone the area. (game text: Increase your Maximum Number of Turrets to 4, but they have 20% less Health.) Field: 50.5% in 3069 games, 41% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.3%.

Loadout crest Soulbearer: A shield, lifesteal on your magic damage, and some speed for a few seconds. Pop it when caught, and your turrets and fire heal you. (game text: Anima:  Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.) Field: 54.2% in 1184 games, 16% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.3%.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 4 effects on one trigger: Golem's Gift, Lifebinder, Caustica, Soulbearer. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Lifebinder, Soulbearer.
Countered? 1 of the 2 players Iggy & Scorch killed built magical armor (Khaimera). Anti-heal on Sparrow, Gadget, Khaimera. We killed Iggy & Scorch 4 times.
Copy it? Too few Iggy & Scorch midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

card.lesson: Inferno came back about every 57s instead of 85s by the end (32% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
